_note: One overhead sprite per plant kind. The crop IDs each sprite covers live in flutter/lib/presentation/canvas/plant_art.dart. desc = what one plant looks like from straight above.
lettuce: a head of green leaf lettuce, a loose round rosette of ruffled bright green leaves
kale: a kale plant, a rosette of large dark blue-green curly ruffled kale leaves with pale midribs
cabbage: a green cabbage plant, a round pale blue-green head in the middle wrapped by broad outer leaves
broccoli: a broccoli plant, a domed green floret head in the centre ringed by large blue-green leaves
cauliflower: a cauliflower plant, a creamy white curd in the centre ringed by large green leaves
chard: a Swiss chard plant, a rosette of glossy crinkled dark green leaves with bright yellow and orange stems
spinach: a spinach plant, a low rosette of smooth glossy dark green rounded leaves
beet: a beet plant, a rosette of green leaves with deep red veins and stems
carrot: a carrot plant, a soft star of finely divided feathery bright green fronds
turnip: a turnip plant, a rosette of rough lobed green leaves with the white and purple top of the root just showing in the middle
onion: an onion plant, a loose star of hollow round blue-green leaves fanning out from the middle
chives: a clump of chives, a dense tuft of thin grass-like hollow green leaves with a few round lavender pompom flowers
leek: a leek plant, flat blue-green strap leaves fanning out in two opposite directions
garlic: a garlic plant, flat narrow green leaves arching out from the centre in a loose star
tomato: a bushy tomato plant, a mass of serrated compound leaves with a few round red tomatoes on top among the leaves
pepper: a bell pepper plant, a bushy mound of glossy pointed oval leaves with the tops of a few green and red peppers peeking through
eggplant: an eggplant plant, a mound of large soft grey-green leaves with a few small violet flowers
bean: a bush bean plant, a mound of heart-shaped green trifoliate leaves
pea: a pea plant, a tangle of rounded pale green leaflets, curling tendrils and a few white flowers
cucumber: a cucumber vine, large lobed rough green leaves, curling tendrils, small yellow flowers and one striped cucumber lying among the leaves
summer_squash: a zucchini plant, a big open rosette of huge lobed leaves with silvery markings and a large yellow flower in the centre
winter_squash: a pumpkin vine, large round lobed green leaves and one round orange pumpkin lying among them
melon: a melon vine, rounded lobed green leaves, tendrils and one netted tan melon lying among them
corn: a corn plant seen from directly above, long arching green blade leaves radiating out in a star from the stalk top with a pale tassel in the middle
potato: a potato plant, a bushy mound of dark green compound leaves with a few small white flowers
basil: a basil plant, a bushy mound of glossy bright green cupped oval leaves in pairs
parsley: a flat-leaf parsley plant, a dense mound of bright green divided serrated leaves
dill: a dill plant, airy thread-like feathery blue-green foliage with a flat yellow flower umbel
thyme: a thyme plant, a low dense cushion of tiny grey-green leaves with a few small pink flowers
rosemary: a rosemary plant, a bushy mound of needle-like dark grey-green leaves
sage: a sage plant, a mound of soft oval pebbly grey-green leaves
mint: a mint plant, a dense patch of bright green toothed oval leaves in pairs
pac_choi: a pac choi plant, a rosette of spoon-shaped glossy dark green leaves with thick white stems
celery: a celery plant, a clump of pale green stalks topped with bright green divided leaves fanning out
okra: an okra plant, large lobed maple-like green leaves with one pale yellow hibiscus-like flower
